latest.author: Anonymus256
latest.text: Great port, runs really well, maintained a steady 120fps at 1440p with barely any stutters. Since this isn't like the pc version of the game, I didn't expect a ton going in, but there are some things I would really like to see added in this port that would make the experience at least a little bit better. Some of theses features include: -Built-in randomizer mode -In-game achievements -Better volume adjustment controls -Microphone support for melody composure (like in the ocarina of time remake…

latest.author: johnnysack34
latest.text: Tried TP on Wii a few time before and could never get into it. This is my first time giving this a “real try” and I just played 5 hours straight. That would have NEVER HAPPENED if this port didn’t run as beautifully as it does. 4k 120fps is rock solid. Dusklight literally made me a fan of TP. The only issue is that the “time played” clock in the save menu is way off.
